items.difficulty_reason: 74 行、四步：①(1) 直接由 negative-vanishing 引理；②(2) 用 nice-K-injective 的 E = Rlim E_n 与 RF 对 Rlim 的交换，写成 Rlim 正合列；③截断三角 + 假设 (2)（R^pF 在 p≥N 消没、拟凝聚性）⇒ H^i(RF(E_n))→H^i(RF(E_{n-1})) 从 n ≥ N-i 起是同构 ⇒ ML 条件 + 从 N-i-1 起恒定 ⇒ R^1lim 为零、lim 项等于有限截断处的值；④(3) 由 (1)(2) 两侧拼出 amplitude 外的消没。承重的 Rlim 计算与 ML 论证都在 span 内；6 处引用（1 同章、5 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-application-nice-K-injective (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 374-393

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the citation of the negative vanishing lemma for the first statement, the computation of the applied functor on the limit through the Rlim short exact sequence, the ML and eventual constancy of the truncated systems derived from the cohomological dimension bound, and the assembly of the amplitude bound from the two one-sided statements (source lines 395-447)
